actions.answer:
- `interrupted_history` in `services/agentd-py/agentd/chat/batch_history.py:6` returns a copied history. For entries that are tool results belonging to a batch and currently `pending`, `waiting_approval`, or `running`, it marks them as interrupted, sets `is_error=True`, and replaces their content with a non-replay notice. All other entries are copied unchanged.
- `batching_enabled` in `services/agentd-py/agentd/tools/batching.py:29` enables tool batching only when `CRUCIBLE_TOOL_BATCHING_ENABLED` is set, case-insensitively, to `1`, `true`, or `yes`; otherwise it returns `False`.
